verdict.rationale: Devin's API docs state directly that sessions can be created on behalf of any user in the organization through the create_as_user_id parameter. That is exactly what the story asks for. The evidence, though, is a single line in the API overview. missing for 10: details on the required permissions or admin role and how attribution and audit work for impersonated sessions, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create agent sessions on behalf of other users in my organization

citations.quote: you can create sessions on behalf of any user in your organization using the create_as_user_id parameter
